title: Upon Our Lord's Sermon On The Mount: Discourse Twelve

passages.locator: https://wesley.nnu.edu/john-wesley/the-sermons-of-john-wesley-1872-edition/sermon-32-upon-our-lords-sermon-on-the-mount-discourse-twelve/; original.html, heading block under the title (block 1): "Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravenous wolves. Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit, but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit. A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down and cast into the fire. Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them." Matt. 7:15-20.
